newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar rises on limited supplies.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar rises on limited supplies.

text.p: Limited arrival helped sugar prices recover on Tuesday from recent slide, traders said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose 30 rupees to 1,420/1,430 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved up 10/15 rupees to 1,455/1,490 rupees.
"Strong outstation demand curtailed supply of sugar to the Bombay market," one broker said.
Sugar mill delivery firmed to 1,360/1,375 rupees per quintal from 1,345/1,355 rupees on outstation demand from neighbouring states like Gujarat, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh.
